name: Pelethites
overview: The Pelethites were a distinct group closely associated with King David's personal security, serving alongside the Cherethites as part of his elite bodyguard under the leadership of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. They are depicted as loyal warriors who accompanied David during critical moments, such as when Solomon was brought to be anointed king, and also formed part of Absalom's escort during his rebellion. Their presence alongside other mighty men highlights their role as trusted protectors and key figures in the king's military and royal household.
